Question: Which scope does a client need to cancel a payment?

Searches already run:
1. cancel payment scope
2. payment cancellation required scope

Collected excerpts:

<excerpt id="payments-api:cancelPayment:operation">
[payments-api] POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/cancellation · operation
operationId: cancelPayment
Summary: Cancel a payment
Description: Cancels a payment that has not been executed yet. A payment can only be cancelled while its status is PENDING.
Tags: Payments
Security: bearerAuth (OAuth2 bearer token in the Authorization header; scopes: payments:write) AND apiKey (API key in header X-Api-Key)
Parameters: paymentId (path), X-Correlation-Id (header)
Responses: 200, 401, 403, 404, 409, 429
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="payments-api:cancelPayment:response:200">
[payments-api] POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/cancellation · response 200
Response 200: The payment, now with the status CANCELLED.
Headers:
- X-Correlation-Id (string): The correlation identifier of the call. It repeats the caller's value, or a generated one when none was sent.
Content application/json: Payment
- paymentId (string, required): Identifier of the payment.
- status (string, enum PENDING|EXECUTED|REJECTED|CANCELLED, required): Current state of the payment.
- debtorAccountId (string, required): Account the money is taken from.
- creditorIban (string, required): IBAN of the beneficiary.
- creditorName (string, optional): Name of the beneficiary.
- amount (Amount, required)
- reference (string, optional): Free-text reference shown to the beneficiary.
- requestedExecutionDate (string, format date, optional): Date on which the payment should be executed.
- createdAt (string, format date-time, optional): When the payment was created.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="payments-api:Payment:component_schema">
[payments-api] component schema Payment
Schema Payment: object
Description: A payment and its state.
Required fields: paymentId, status, debtorAccountId, creditorIban, amount
- paymentId (string, required): Identifier of the payment.
- status (string, enum PENDING|EXECUTED|REJECTED|CANCELLED, required): Current state of the payment.
- debtorAccountId (string, required): Account the money is taken from.
- creditorIban (string, required): IBAN of the beneficiary.
- creditorName (string, optional): Name of the beneficiary.
- amount (Amount, required)
- reference (string, optional): Free-text reference shown to the beneficiary.
- requestedExecutionDate (string, format date, optional): Date on which the payment should be executed.
- createdAt (string, format date-time, optional): When the payment was created.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="payments-api:cancelPayment:response:403">
[payments-api] POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/cancellation · response 403
Response 403: The access token is valid but does not carry the scope the operation requires. The Problem `code` is `AUTH-002`.
Content application/problem+json: Problem
- type (string, format uri, required): URI that identifies the kind of problem.
- title (string, required): Short, human-readable summary of the problem.
- status (integer, required): HTTP status code of the response.
- code (string, required): Lab Bank error code, for example AUTH-001.
- detail (string, required): Explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
- correlationId (string, optional): Correlation identifier of the failed call.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="payments-api:bearerAuth:security_scheme">
[payments-api] security scheme bearerAuth
Type: oauth2
Description: OAuth 2.0 access token obtained from the token endpoint with the client credentials grant. The token is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Each operation lists the scope it needs.
Flow clientCredentials: token URL https://api.labbank.example/oauth/token
- scope customers:read: Read customer profiles, linked accounts and consents.
- scope customers:write: Change customer contact details.
- scope accounts:read: Read accounts, balances and transactions.
- scope statements:read: Read and request account statements.
- scope payments:write: Initiate, read and cancel payments.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="payments-api:cancelPayment:parameters">
[payments-api] POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/cancellation · parameters
- paymentId (path, required, string): Identifier of the payment.
- X-Correlation-Id (header, optional, string, max length 64): Optional identifier chosen by the caller to trace a call across systems. It is echoed in the X-Correlation-Id response header and in the Problem correlationId field.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="payments-api:cancelPayment:response:409">
[payments-api] POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/cancellation · response 409
Response 409: The payment can no longer be cancelled because its status is not PENDING. The Problem `code` is `PAY-410`.
Content application/problem+json: Problem
- type (string, format uri, required): URI that identifies the kind of problem.
- title (string, required): Short, human-readable summary of the problem.
- status (integer, required): HTTP status code of the response.
- code (string, required): Lab Bank error code, for example AUTH-001.
- detail (string, required): Explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
- correlationId (string, optional): Correlation identifier of the failed call.
</excerpt>
